My app is still not working. I need it to he fixed asap.

Hi Team, The MoveInSync app is forcing users to grant microphone access, even though it does not provide any direct in-app calling feature and all calls are routed through the regular phone dialer. Could you please clarify why microphone permission is mandatory? If it is not essential for the core functionality of the app, please stop forcing users to grant this permission and allow the app to function without it. Greater transparency around permission requirements would be appreciated.

Just opening this app takes forever because they want to show 1. A full screen opening animation 2. Popup window with festive greetings and 3. A UI that need full network connectivity just to load. Even a simple web page would perform better than this app. It is the slowest Android app I have used yet it would be needed for time critical moments when you need to check the OTP or track cab position etc. Hope the companies who hire MoveInSync are reading this!

Removed the option to rate rides. The app is good for booking and getting cab details. Earlier, until a few months ago, you could rate a ride, or provide feedback on it, but not anymore. Now, the driver may come half an hour late, not come at all, but there is nothing you can do to report it. This sucks.

It's a good app for transportation but it should be better if there is an option for a chat or call driver for the same. As sometimes due to network issues we are not able to receive the calls from the driver so in that case that would be useful if we have an option for chatting with the driver or else we can call them once we are in the network zone.
